definitions.explanation: A self-propelled vehicle that provides the motive power for pulling or pushing a train along railway tracks.

examples.japanese: {蒸気|じょうき}{機関車|きかんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{機関車|きかんしゃ}トーマス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧だった。
examples.english: When I was a child, I loved Thomas the Tank Engine.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蒸気|じょうき}{機関車|きかんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Old steam locomotives are on display at this museum.

notes:
{機関車|きかんしゃ} is composed of ⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧ (engine, mechanism) + ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). It refers specifically to the engine unit of a train that pulls or pushes the other cars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蒸気|じょうき}{機関車|きかんしゃ}: steam locomotive (abbreviated SL)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{機関車|きかんしゃ}: electric locomotive
- ディーゼル{機関車|きかんしゃ}: diesel locomotive
- {機関車|きかんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{牽引|けんいん}→牽引：13498_kenin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a locomotive pulls (a train)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: electric train — a self-propelled electric passenger train (the most common type in Japan)
- ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧: train — the train as a whole unit, including all cars
- ⟦{汽車|きしゃ}→汽車：01381_kisha⟧: steam train — older term; in some regional dialects, any train

CULTURAL NOTE:
Steam locomotives ({蒸気|じょうき}{機関車|きかんしゃ}, often abbreviated as SL) hold nostalgic appeal in Japan. Several tourist SL lines operate around the country, and {機関車|きかんしゃ}トーマス (Thomas the Tank Engine) is enormously popular among Japanese children.
